audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown appears anywhere on the full layer, and dosFull[2].d invents one: "take the fifteen-second invitation" after a Lightning Rush. Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s. Slicing Maelstrom, the actual lane-defining ultimate, is never given its 120s.
audit.why: Ten seconds is a trade window; fifteen is a recall. A player counting to fifteen after his E gets caught by the next one.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry 10s at rank 1; phases[3].why carries the 950-range 5.5s Thundering Shuriken and phases[4].why the 120s Slicing Maelstrom.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer attributes the stun to Lightning Rush — "His engage and escape — the stun chain starts here" — in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t. Kennen has no stun on E. Mark of the Storm stuns only on the THIRD application, and Q (950 range) plus W (725) are what stack it; Lightning Rush contributes one mark at 170 range, i.e. only when he is already on top of you.
audit.why: It points the player at the wrong tell. Counting Lightning Rush tells you nothing about whether you are one mark from being stunned mid-kite, which is the only thing that kills Lillia here.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now say the stun is three Marks and tell the player to count Q and W rather than the Rush.
